source: MAFF/GIZ, "Guidelines for Banana Export from Cambodia to China" (German Cooperation/GIZ SRECA, 2022), section 1.3
text:
This export guide opens its discussion of Cambodian fruit products by starting with banana specifically, describing it as the country's leading fruit export crop. It notes the scientific name Musa sapientum for the cultivated eating banana, and separately mentions that the Chek Pong Moan variety (Musa Aromatica) has been referred to in some sources as Cambodia's national fruit — a claim the guide cites from an outside blog source rather than an official government designation, so it should be treated as a commonly repeated fact rather than a verified legal status.

The broader point the guide makes is that banana, among all of Cambodia's fruit crops, has progressed furthest toward formal export readiness: it was the first Cambodian fruit product to receive official market access approval from China's customs authority (GACC) under a bilateral phytosanitary protocol, which is why the rest of this guide uses banana repeatedly as its running example when explaining registration, packing house, and quality requirements for exporting fresh fruit to China.
